title: Globus transport backend
description: Add a Globus transport (globus-sdk / globus-cli) plus a transiently-run Globus Connect Personal endpoint, as a new endpoint kind in crypt4gh/pack/transport.py. Fits the existing stage-in-working-then-push model since Globus moves files at rest, not pipes. Reserve globus:ENDPOINT_ID:/path syntax. Optional dep already declared: pip install .[globus].

title: Per-user Globus Connect Personal installer (Linux)
description: Automate 'download + install a per-user copy of Globus Connect Personal if not already on PATH', per https://docs.globus.org/globus-connect-personal/install/linux/. Stdlib-only Python so it can bootstrap before the venv. Installs the distribution under ~/.local/share/gcp/ and a launcher symlink at ~/.local/bin/globusconnectpersonal. Idempotent (no-op if globusconnectpersonal already on PATH; --force to reinstall). Linux-only. Prints computed sha256 and supports --sha256 pinning. Fallback for the unmanaged-both-ends case; the transport should prefer an existing managed collection + HTTPS when available.
close_reason: Implemented crypt4gh/pack/gcp_install.py (crypt4gh-install-gcp) with unit tests; README + CHANGELOG updated.

title: Encrypt-at-source (RemoteCryptor)
description: Add a RemoteCryptor implementing the crypto.Cryptor interface that runs crypt4gh on the host holding the plaintext, so only ciphertext crosses the transport (zero-trust; important for Globus). Pipeline is already crypto-pluggable: crypt4gh/pack/crypto.py, pipeline.py.

title: Scale hardening for millions of files
description: Avoid materializing full in-memory lists at PB / millions-of-files scale: stream enumeration into the pool, chunk the pool, and share the cryptor via a pool initializer instead of per-item pickling (crypt4gh/pack/api.py, pipeline.py). Review finding 7.

title: Bounded staging: --xfer-chunk-size
description: Bound the working-dir high-water-mark: transform a chunk, transport it, free the space, repeat, instead of staging the full output set (crypt4gh/pack/api.py). Adds --xfer-chunk-size. Needed for petabyte-scale runs with limited scratch.

title: Tar-unpack partial cleanup on error
description: unpack_item removes partial file outputs on error but not partial tar extractions (crypt4gh/pack/pipeline.py). Clean up or quarantine a partially-extracted tar item files on failure.

title: Implement --resume for pack/unpack
description: Resume interrupted runs using the SQLite catalog (crypt4gh/pack/catalog.py): skip items already status=done whose source is unchanged (size+mtime, optionally sha256). The catalog schema already records these fields for exactly this.

title: Remote-side compression over ssh
description: For remote-source packs, run the compressor on the far side of ssh (e.g. ssh host tar ... | zstd) to cut bytes on the wire, instead of compressing locally after transfer (crypt4gh/pack/fs.py RemoteFS, pipeline.py).

title: Configurable --tar-depth (incl. =auto)
description: Let --tar operate at a configurable directory depth instead of only top-level subdirs (crypt4gh/pack/api.py _enumerate_pack). Include a --tar-depth=auto heuristic. Finer depth improves resume granularity.
